items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser to keep oily-feeling skin on the chest and shoulders clean without irritation.

response.routine_note: Wash the chest and shoulders once or twice a day and after sweating, and rinse well, especially near areas your baby touches. Because you are breastfeeding I have left out acids, retinoids and peroxides, so if the spots persist or bother you, please check with a pharmacist or dermatologist before adding anything stronger.
